footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Infinity Natural Resources: includes a $4.9M income tax benefit; after $50.1M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 37.6% to $356M in 2025. Operating income fell 87.3% to $11.9M, a 3.3% margin.
Net income was $13.8M, or $0.89 per share, after a $0 loss a year earlier. Operating cash flow was $262M and free cash flow $249M, versus $171M.
watch: Net income includes a $4.9M tax benefit.
